idea-plugin.name: OpenUnderstand Metrics
idea-plugin.description:
Java source metrics (Cyclomatic, CountLine, MaxNesting, CountDeclMethod, PercentLackOfCohesion, CountClassCoupled) from OpenUnderstand, an open-source implementation of the SciTools Understand API.

Requires python3 3.9+ on the path. The analyser ships with the plugin and installs itself into a virtualenv of its own the first time you press Analyse Project; nothing to configure.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2
  • Fixed: the plugin icon was not well-formed XML. A double hyphen inside an XML comment ends the document for a strict parser, so the icon shipped in 0.1.1 failed to load.
  • Ships a newer build of the analyser.
0.1.1
  • Compatibility. Requires 2025.1 or later. 0.1.0 declared 2024.2+ but was built against 2025.1, and was binary incompatible with 2024.2 and 2024.3 -- it called a FileSaverDescriptor constructor that is a varargs one on those builds. Verified against 2025.1 through 2026.2.
  • Fixed: the analysis could fail with 'openunderstand' is not a package. The dumper was written to the shared temp directory, and Python puts a script's own directory first on its path, so a file left there by an earlier run shadowed the analyser. It is unpacked into a private directory now.
  • No interpreter to configure. The Python... button and the search of the machine are gone. The plugin builds a virtualenv of its own with python3 and installs the analyser it ships with, once, on the first Analyse Project.
  • Fixed: numeric columns sorted as text -- 10 came before 2 -- because the table reported every column as untyped. Double-clicking a row now only navigates, instead of also opening the cell for editing.
  • Metrics: CountDeclMethodProtected and CountDeclMethodDefault counted methods by matching the class name against the method's own name, so most classes reported 0. Both now agree with Understand (F1 1.000 and 0.949 on the JSON benchmark).
